name: Anagakusum Rasa

sections.introduction: Anagakusum rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation. This formulation is helpful in sexual disorders like impotency, erectile dysfunction, premature ejaculation etc.
sections.ingredients:
Suvarana Bhasma (Gold Powder): This is a nervous tonic and improves overall health. It increases strength and improves mental as well as physical performance. This is effective in loss of vitality, tuberculosis, toxicity, infertility etc. 
 Mukta Pishti (Pearl Calcium): This is an Ayurvedic medicine helpful in reducing heat in the body and brings coolness in the digestive system. It is effective in infertility and also has anti-cancer, anti-stress, and antidepressant properties.   
 Kasturi ( Abelmoschus moschatus ): This is a secretion from the animal Moschus moschiferus or popularly known as musk deer. This kasturi is used in the treatment of psychiatric disorders, neurological diseases, reproductive disorders etc. 
 Hartal Sattva (Arsenic): This mineral is very effective in cancerous diseases and also reproductive disorders. This is prepared from Orpiment (arsenic trioxide). It balances kapha and pitta dosha. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Mix each of the above mentioned ingredients in a kharal yantra and give proper frolement 
 Add 1 bhavna of aloevera juice. 
 Make tablets of 500 mg and dry them. 
 Store these tablets in an airtight glass container. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Anang kusum ras is an effective aphrodisiac. It is very helpful in those patients who have premature ejaculation, difficulty in sexual intercourse as this formulation contains Swarna bhasma and kasturi. This formulation increases the shukar dhatu (testosterone level) and hence nourishes the seven dhatus i.e. ras, rakta, mansa, meda, asthi, majja and shukr. So this formulation gives strength to the patient and increases his sexual power.

 Add 1 bhavna of aloevera juice.
